metadata.description: Five federal acquisition and GovCon workflow plugins

plugins.name: pre-award-agent
plugins.description: Build a SOW/PWS and IGCE; startup discloses limited BLS and Per Diem fallback when optional keys are absent.

plugins.name: other-transaction-agent
plugins.description: Build an OT project description and cost analysis; startup discloses limited BLS and Per Diem fallback.

plugins.name: govcon-growth-agent
plugins.description: Research federal growth; SAM.gov work requires SAM_API_KEY and startup reports when it is not configured.

plugins.name: market-research-agent
plugins.description: Conduct acquisition market research; SAM.gov work requires SAM_API_KEY and startup reports when it is not configured.

plugins.name: acquisition-policy-agent
plugins.description: Trace acquisition policy; startup discloses the limited Regulations.gov DEMO_KEY fallback when no user key is configured.
